title: dryopteris filix-mas subsp. patentissima
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. patentissima, commonly known as the Patented Male Fern, is a subspecies of the Male Fern plant, which is a type of deciduous, evergreen fern native to Europe and western Asia. The Patented Male Fern has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and promote the healing of wounds. The bioactive constituents of the Patented Male Fern include compounds like arachidic acid, arachin, and mannitol, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
